title: Pregnant Blend 2-Mix Solo #16 (대각 띠 3구역·물결)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing or kneeling as described.

Subject: Norwegian woman, an adult, in her late 20s, sultry expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy, her upper body so wide. A mythologically, legendarily enormous bust dominates her upper silhouette, resting heavy and full, far wider than her own shoulders — and below it, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects forward just as prominently, the bust and the belly together forming the two dominant curves of her frame. Round hips and soft thighs continue below. Her head looks small between her massive bust and belly. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, fair skin with a light scatter of freckles, strong straight defined dark-blonde brows, warm bronze shadow across the lids, a fine brown liner, long lashes, large pale-blue eyes with bright real catchlights, soft contour, a muted red-brown lip, a fierce, steady, commanding expression, warm auburn red-brown hair styled in long locs gathered loosely, real pores, real living eyes, 50 hoops piercings set with amethysts in rose-gold-toned metal, wearing two to three pieces of gold a bracelet. Full body painted in 2 different traditional patterns repeated across 3 regions of her figure, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, the patterns reading as a continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 3 diagonal bands by 2 parallel hazy transition zones running from the upper left to the lower right as seen by the camera, crossing the centre line of her figure about 32% of the way down her figure from the top and about 54% of the way down her figure from the top. The regions alternate between 2 patterns in a repeating order. Region 1 is everything on the upper side of the first diagonal transition zone: it is painted in Portuguese azulejo tile (a brilliant white ground with deep cobalt-blue floral borders), wide cobalt bands following the contours of the body, with repeating panel scrollwork filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the diagonal band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Spanish Andalusian filigree (a deep black ground with fine silver filigree in geometric star patterns), wide silver bands following the contours of the body, with geometric star filigree filling the space between bands. Region 3 is everything on the lower side of the last diagonal transition zone: it is painted in the same pattern as Region 1. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring patterns dissolve into each other, motifs from one thinning out as motifs from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating course, rippling softly rather than staying perfectly regular. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one pattern, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The bands of every pattern curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare. Pose: kneeling on one knee, the other raised, one hand on the raised knee and the other cradling her belly, soft warm expression, her whole silhouette filling the frame from head to her extreme platform thigh-skimming boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Lighting: a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus head to toe, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait, taller than it is wide.
